theorem extracted_1.{u_2, u_1} {G : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [hG : MeasurableSpace G]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSingletonClass G] {Ω : Type u_2} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
  [inst_3 : IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : Fin 4 → Ω → G) (h_indep : iIndepFun (fun x => hG) Y μ)
  (h_meas : ∀ (i : Fin 4), Measurable (Y i)) :
  let π := AddMonoidHom.fst G G - AddMonoidHom.snd G G;
  (∀ {W_1 W_2 : Ω → G}, ⇑π ∘ ⟨W_1, W_2⟩ = W_1 - W_2) →
    let Z_1 := ⟨Y 0, Y 2⟩;
    let Z_2 := ⟨Y 1, Y 3⟩;
    Z_1 - Z_2 = ⟨Y 0 - Y 1, Y 2 - Y 3⟩ →
      Measurable Z_1 →
        Measurable Z_2 →
          IndepFun (Y 0) (Y 1) μ →
            d[Y 0 ; μ # Y 1 ; μ] + d[Y 2 ; μ # Y 3 ; μ] =
              d[Y 0 - Y 2 ; μ # Y 1 - Y 3 ; μ] + d[Y 0 | Y 0 - Y 2 ; μ # Y 1 | Y 1 - Y 3 ; μ] +
                I[Y 0 - Y 1 : Y 1 - Y 3|Y 0 - Y 1 - Y 2 + Y 3;μ] := sorry
